chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Ziyād, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from his forefathers, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
When the camel has risen with its load, then its owner has become liable.

key_terms.إِذَا: when; introducing the condition for the ruling
key_terms.ضَمِنَ: became liable or responsible for compensation

ai.seo_question: When does the owner of a loaded camel become legally liable according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for an animal after it has stood up carrying its load. It indicates that once the camel is upright with the load, responsibility and guarantee fall upon its owner.
